info.title: here.now API
info.summary: API for publishing Sites to live URLs, plus Drives, Site Data, analytics, profiles, and domains.
info.description: here.now lets agents publish static Sites to live URLs. The API also covers private Drive storage, Site Data, analytics, profiles, domains, and variables. This OpenAPI spec covers stable public API routes and intentionally excludes admin/internal endpoints.

parameters.name: X-HereNow-Account
parameters.description: Which of the caller's accounts the request acts as: a workspace subdomain or account UUID (GET /api/v1/accounts lists them and the current selection). Omit for the personal account. Required to address workspace-owned Sites and workspace domains, mounts, and variables; refused with 403 (code account_forbidden) when the caller is not an active member. When the request body also carries `account`, the two must agree.

post.description: Creates a pending Site version and returns presigned upload URLs. The upload URLs PUT directly to storage at *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com (the exact host is in each URL), not to here.now; environments with an egress allowlist must permit that host as well. Optional displayName and displayDescription set owner-facing Site metadata. Anonymous requests are allowed and create temporary Sites that expire after 24 hours.

get.description: Without scope, lists the selected account's Sites (personal by default; a workspace with X-HereNow-Account), newest updatedAt first. With scope=all, lists everything the caller can see across their personal account, accepted shared Sites, and all joined workspaces — cursor-paginated, with ownership/workspace annotations per row, ordered by contentUpdatedAt (most recent content change; shared rows by when they were shared with you), the same order as the dashboard. scope=all cannot be combined with an account selector.

get.description: Returns the Site's metadata and the full manifest of its current live version. currentVersionSource and currentVersionCreatedAt attribute the live version (publish-finalize, studio, duplicate-site, ...; the same vocabulary as the version_conflict details), so before editing local files an agent can compare currentVersionId with the version it last published and explain any drift. File bytes are not included: read them with GET /api/v1/publish/{slug}/files/{path}.

put.description: Creates a pending replacement version for an existing Site and returns presigned upload URLs, which PUT directly to storage at *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com (allow that host alongside here.now in egress-restricted environments). Settings follow patch semantics: omitted ttlSeconds/viewer preserve current values, explicit null clears them, and viewer fields merge individually; staged TTL changes apply at finalize. Optional displayName and displayDescription update owner-facing Site metadata. Authenticated Sites require API key ownership. Anonymous Sites require claimToken (an API key on an anonymous Site neither authorizes the update nor claims the Site — use POST /api/v1/publish/{slug}/claim). While a finalize is in flight for the Site's pending version, updates return 409 with code finalize_in_flight and a Retry-After — retry after a few seconds. Optional baseVersionId declares the currentVersionId your files were derived from (optimistic concurrency): if the live version has moved past it, the update — and its later finalize — return 409 with code version_conflict and details naming the current version; fetch the live Site and reconcile, or republish without baseVersionId to overwrite. Omitting baseVersionId is an unchecked full replacement.

post.description: Makes a pending version live after all files have been uploaded, and applies any staged settings (TTL). Idempotent by versionId: retrying a finalize that already succeeded returns the live state with replayed:true instead of an error. Finalize claims the pending version exclusively while running — concurrent finalizes of the same version, and updates/deletes during the claim, return 409 (finalize_in_flight) with a Retry-After. If the update declared a baseVersionId and the live version moved past it before finalize, the finalize returns 409 with code version_conflict and nothing goes live. The response's publishStatus is the authoritative ownership/persistence state.

post.summary: Restore a recorded version as the live Site
post.description: Instantly makes a previously recorded version the live one (a pointer flip — no re-upload). Content, rendering settings, API proxies, and Site Data schema follow the restored version; access mode, password, price, and domains stay as currently configured. The restore is recorded in the version history as a restore event. Rejected while a publish is in flight. Requires ownership; included for workspace Sites, paid plan for personal Sites.

post.description: Transfers an anonymous Site to the authenticated account or browser session using a claim token. Token verification and ownership transfer are one atomic update, and claiming is retry-safe: repeating a claim that already succeeded for the same account returns success with alreadyOwned:true, while a Site claimed by another account returns 409 (already_claimed). Structurally invalid tokens — including claim URLs shortened with '...' — return 400 (malformed_token). Users can also claim in the browser by opening the claimUrl and signing in.

get.summary: Read one file from the live version
get.description: Returns the stored bytes of one file in the Site's current live version, with the manifest's content type, Content-Length, an ETag equal to the file's sha256, and X-HereNow-Version naming the version read. This is owner management access, not public serving: it works for password-protected and restricted Sites without the visitor password, and public visitor behavior is unchanged. Only paths present in the current manifest are readable (404 otherwise); reserved .herenow/ manifests are readable like any other published file. Use it to inspect a Site before editing, to reconcile local files after a version_conflict, or to export a Site. Cache-Control is private, no-store. HEAD returns the same headers (Content-Type, Content-Length, ETag, X-HereNow-Version) without the body, for checking a file's hash or size before downloading it. A 503 with code service_unavailable and a Retry-After header means storage did not answer in time; retry after the given seconds.

patch.summary: Patch Site metadata and access controls
patch.description: Updates owner-facing displayName and displayDescription, TTL, viewer metadata, password protection, and SPA routing for an authenticated Site. Setting a password switches the Site to password access mode (a public link gated by a shared password) and clears restricted email/domain rules. Sending password null removes an existing password and returns the Site to anyone_with_link (public); on a Site without a password it is a no-op and does not change the access mode. Workspace-owned Sites support passwords (publisher-or-admin): workspace members see the Site in their dashboard but enter the password to view it, like any visitor.

patch.summary: Update Site access mode and allowlists
patch.description: Sets link or restricted access for an owned Site. The request replaces the full email and domain allowlists; to add one entry, read the current policy, merge, and write the complete lists back. A successful PATCH switches the Site away from password mode and clears any existing password. Restricted access requires a claimed Site (409 otherwise). To enable password mode, use the metadata endpoint instead (mode password here returns 409). On workspace-owned Sites (X-HereNow-Account), restricted means workspace members plus a per-Site guest allowlist: members always have access, allowlisted emails/domains are outside guests who can view only that Site, and at least one guest email or domain is required (empty allowlists return 400 — use account_members for members-only). When notify is true, invite emails are sent only to exact-email addresses newly added by this request; domain rules never send invite emails.

bearerAuth.description: Use `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Drive share tokens also use Bearer auth for Drive-scoped operations.

ErrorResponse.description: Structured JSON error envelope. The `error` field is retained for backwards compatibility; agents should prefer `code`, `message`, `retry_after`, and `docs_url` when present.

details.description: Optional route-specific details. May be a string, object, or array.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Also mirrored in the Retry-After header when present.

keyName.description: Optional per-tool key name (e.g. "cli"). When provided, the response's apiKey is a named hnk_ key for that tool instead of the account's legacy shared key — reusing the existing active key with that name (keyReused: true) or minting a new one. If minting fails (key cap or rate limit), the response falls back to the legacy key and sets keyMintError.

apiKeyId.description: Present when keyName resolved to a named key (minted or reused).

apiKeyName.description: Present when keyName resolved to a named key (minted or reused).

keyReused.description: True when an existing active key with the same name was returned instead of minting a duplicate.

keyMintError.description: Present when keyName was provided but minting failed; apiKey is then the legacy shared key.

path.description: Site-relative file path. Paths under .herenow/ are reserved configuration manifests processed by here.now rather than served to visitors: .herenow/data.json declares Site Data collections (https://here.now/docs#sitedata) and .herenow/proxy.json declares server-side proxy routes with variable-injected headers (https://here.now/docs#proxy-routes).

ViewerMetadataPatch.description: Viewer metadata patch. On update: omitting the whole object preserves the existing viewer; null clears it; within the object, omitted fields preserve, null clears, values set (a title-only patch never erases an existing description).

PublishStatus.description: Authoritative auth/ownership/persistence state. Clients must report from these fields and never infer them from request shape (an API key on an anonymous-Site update does not claim or convert the Site).

persistence.description: Effective post-finalize persistence. On pending responses this accounts for pendingTtl intent (a staged TTL reports expiring; a staged clear reports permanent) while expiresAt stays the currently live value.

state.description: pending: values describe intent until finalize. live: values describe the live Site (finalize responses are authoritative).

pendingTtl.description: Present on pending-state responses when a TTL change is staged; applied at finalize.

ttlSeconds.description: Authenticated only. On update: omitted preserves the current TTL, null clears it, a number stages a new TTL. Staged TTL changes apply at finalize (never at request time), with expiry running from the finalize timestamp.

baseVersionId.description: Update only (rejected on create). Optimistic concurrency: the currentVersionId these files were derived from. If the live version differs at update or finalize time, the request fails with 409 code version_conflict (details include currentVersionId and, when known, currentVersionSource/currentVersionCreatedAt). Omit for an unchecked full replacement.

account.description: Optional account selector for authenticated requests (workspace subdomain or account UUID). Must match X-HereNow-Account when both are provided. Selecting a workspace makes the Site workspace-owned.

displayName.description: Optional owner-facing Site title for dashboards, search, profile cards, and API responses.

displayDescription.description: Optional owner-facing Site summary for dashboards, search, and API responses.

claimToken.description: Anonymous Sites only. Returned exactly once and cannot be recovered. Compact tokens are 16 base64url characters; legacy 64-char hex tokens remain valid.

claimUrl.description: Anonymous Sites only (https://here.now/c/<token>). Share with the user copied byte-for-byte as a clickable link — never shorten, redact, summarize, or replace any part of it with '...'. A modified claim link will not work.

account.description: Optional account selector for authenticated requests. Must match X-HereNow-Account when both are provided.

workspaceLabel.description: Optional exact DNS-safe label for beta workspace-owned Sites. When omitted, finalize derives a label from generated Site metadata with a deterministic fallback. Explicit labels stay strict: conflicts return 409 instead of auto-bumping.
Workspace label allocation details when finalizing a beta workspace-owned Site.

unchanged.description: True when the finalized content was identical to the already-live version, so no new version was created. currentVersionId is the existing live versionId (it will differ from the versionId minted by create/update). Settings changes carried by the update (TTL, viewer, spaMode) are still applied.

replayed.description: True when this versionId had already been finalized (finalize is idempotent by versionId; retries after timeouts and concurrent-finalize losers receive the authoritative live state instead of an error).

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems with reserved manifest files, present only when there are any. Most important case: a .herenow/proxy.json that is invalid JSON or does not match the required {"proxies": {"/path": {...}}} shape does NOT fail the publish — the Site goes live with proxy routes silently disabled, and the mistake surfaces here. Route keys that do not start with "/" also warn (they can never match a request). Always check this field after finalizing a Site that carries .herenow/ manifests.

source.description: Pipeline that produced the version: publish-finalize, from-drive, console-save, console-chat, studio, studio-new-site, duplicate-site, dashboard-new-site, or backfill.

restoredFromVersionId.description: Set when this entry records a rollback to an earlier version.

clientSource.description: Normalized client that published the version, from the X-HereNow-Client header (e.g. cursor, claude_code, codex, openclaw, bot, api, dashboard, herenow_cli). Null for versions that predate attribution capture.

clientLabel.description: Human display label for clientSource: the agent's name ("Cursor"), a self-identified bot's name ("henry"), or "API" for bare HTTP clients. Null when the bucket has no display label.

current.description: True for the version currently being served.

thumbnailUrl.description: Relative URL of the version's screenshot; requires the same authentication and plan as this endpoint.

previewUrl.description: Owner-only preview of this version at {versionId}--{slug}.here.now. Opening it in a signed-in browser authenticates automatically; the preview is never publicly accessible or indexed.

eventVersionId.description: Id of the restore event recorded in the version history.

updatedAt.description: When the Site's record last changed for any reason (content, access mode, password, TTL, primary domain, staging a version).

contentUpdatedAt.description: scope=all only: when the live content last changed (a new version went live, a restore, a duplicate, or the Site was claimed). Settings changes do not move it. The list is ordered by this value.

primaryUrl.description: scope=all only: the Site's primary address — its primary custom domain if one is set, else its most recently connected custom domain, else the workspace label URL, else the canonical siteUrl. The same address the dashboard shows.

workspace.description: scope=all only: the owning workspace for workspace rows.

scope.description: Present when the request used scope=all.

nextCursor.description: scope=all only: opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

primaryUrl.description: The Site's primary address as last indexed: primary custom domain, else its most recently connected custom domain, else the workspace label URL, else siteUrl.

workspace.description: Owning workspace, present on workspace-owned results.

updatedAt.description: When the Site's record last changed for any reason.

contentUpdatedAt.description: When the live content last changed (new version, restore, duplicate, or claim). Settings changes do not move it.

SiteDataRecordInput.description: Record data validated against the target collection schema from .herenow/data.json. Allowed fields and value types depend on that collection.

data.description: Projected record data after validation against the current collection schema.

currentVersionSource.description: What made the live version live: publish-finalize, studio, studio-new-site, duplicate-site, from-drive, dashboard-new-site, console-save, console-chat, or backfill; a restore reports the restore event. null when unattributed (versions that predate history).

currentVersionCreatedAt.description: When the live version went live (the restore time after a restore). null when unattributed.

currentVersionId.description: The live version the listing (and every url) reads from.

hash.description: sha256 of the file bytes; also the ETag the read endpoint returns.

url.description: GET this (with the same Authorization header) for the file bytes.

label.description: Vanity label for workspace sites served at {label}.{subdomain} hosts.

claimToken.description: The complete, unmodified claimToken from the publish response.

alreadyOwned.description: True when this account had already claimed the Site; the retry is reported as success.

displayName.description: Owner-facing Site title for dashboards, search, profile cards, and API responses.

displayDescription.description: Owner-facing Site summary for dashboards, search, and API responses.

metadata.description: Returned when displayName or displayDescription is updated.

mode.description: Active access mode for the Site.

accessPolicyVersion.description: Increments on every access change. Changing the policy invalidates older viewer grants.

allowedEmails.description: Exact-email allowlist. Empty unless mode is restricted.

allowedDomains.description: Email-domain allowlist. Empty unless mode is restricted.

notifications.description: Present on PATCH responses when notify is true and invite emails were sent or skipped.

mode.description: Target access mode. Use account_members only for workspace-owned Sites. On workspace-owned Sites, restricted means workspace members plus the guest allowlists and requires at least one allowedEmails or allowedDomains entry. Use the metadata endpoint to enable password mode (personal and workspace Sites).

allowedEmails.description: Full replacement exact-email allowlist. Used only with restricted mode. Normalized to lowercase.

allowedDomains.description: Full replacement email-domain allowlist (e.g. example.com). Used only with restricted mode. Normalized to lowercase.

notify.description: When true, sends invite emails to exact-email addresses newly added by this request, up to 200 newly added addresses per request (400 and nothing saved beyond that; use notify false and the invites endpoint in batches). Confirm with the user before sending.

token.description: Secret token value. Returned only when created.

verification.description: Verification progress, present while status is pending (detail endpoint only). state "verifying" means no action is needed: verification normally completes within 20 minutes of the DNS records being added, so keep polling rather than deleting and re-adding the domain (recreating restarts verification and disconnects mounted Sites). state "action_required" means the DNS records likely need fixing; compare them against dns_instructions.

verification_errors.description: Deprecated. Actionable verification guidance, present only when verification.state is action_required. Use verification instead.

mounts.description: Mounts serving Sites on this domain.

mount_path.description: Path on the domain; empty string is the root mount.
Mount path on the domain; empty string for root.

location.description: Deprecated alias of mount_path (still returned for compatibility).

mountId.description: Opaque identifier for this domain mount, returned by the primary-domain endpoints and accepted by PrimaryDomainUpdateRequest as an alternative to domain+mount_path addressing. The /api/v1/mounts responses identify mounts by mount_path instead and do not return this ID.

slugHost.description: The Site's {slug}.here.now host the redirect applies to (workspace label hosts redirect too).

PrimaryDomainUpdateRequest.description: Pass exactly one addressing mode: domain (+ optional mount_path when the Site is mounted at multiple paths on that domain), or mountId. Null in domain or mountId stops redirecting.

mount_path.description: Disambiguates when the Site has multiple mounts on the domain; "" targets the root mount.
Path on the host; empty string mounts at the root.

domain.description: Custom domain to mount on. Omit for the personal subdomain handle.
Custom domain the mount lives on. Omit for the personal subdomain handle.

mount_path.description: Path on the host; empty string is the root mount.

LinkRequest.description: Deprecated alias of MountRequest: location is the mount path.

LinkResponse.description: Deprecated alias of MountResponse: location is the mount path.

label.description: Exact workspace URL label, e.g. `q3-board-deck` in `q3-board-deck.zora.here.now`.

slug.description: Active Site slug already owned by the workspace account.

kvSynced.description: Whether label routing KV was synced immediately. A false value means the dirty namespace queue can reconcile later.

iconEmoji.description: Workspace icon: a single emoji, or null when unset.

selector.description: Selector values for X-HereNow-Account / body account. Prefer the immutable id for stored automations.

joinable.description: Only present with includeJoinable=1: workspaces the caller could join right now via an active auto-join rule matching their email domain.

domain.description: The email domain whose active auto-join rule makes the caller eligible.

joinEndpoint.description: POST here to join (the domain-rules apply endpoint).

subdomain.description: Workspace subdomain to claim ({subdomain}.here.now). Omit to create the workspace without a home; provisioning requires it.

provisioning.description: Provisioning readiness when a subdomain was claimed. status=active means the workspace home and label URLs are ready; degraded includes a retryEndpoint.

label.description: New DNS-safe workspace label. The old label becomes a temporary redirect.

redirect.description: Redirect tombstone route for the previous label; null when renaming to the same label.

avatarUrl.description: Profile picture URL when the member signed in with Google; null otherwise.

source.description: How the membership was created (e.g. invite, domain_rule, creator).

email.description: Email of an existing here.now user.
The invited email (the caller's sign-in email).

acceptEndpoint.description: POST here to accept the invite.

declineEndpoint.description: POST here to decline the invite.

WorkspaceUpdateRequest.description: At least one property is required.

iconEmoji.description: Single emoji, or null to clear the icon.

value.description: The secret value (up to 4 KB). Stored encrypted; never returned.

allowedUpstreams.description: Optional upstream host pinning: the variable is only injected into proxy-route requests whose upstream host is listed (e.g. ["api.openai.com"]). Omit or null for no restriction. Omitting it on an update clears a previous pin.

id.description: Key UUID, or `legacy` for the original sign-up key.

name.description: Key label; blank for the original sign-up key.

keySuffix.description: Last 4 characters of the key, for display.

current.description: True for the key that authenticated this request.

limit.description: Maximum active named keys per account.

name.description: Label for the key, e.g. the agent or tool that will use it (claude, cursor).
